handoffs.message: Implementation merged via PR #4144 at 77ce7f90927a84f659d86d2ddbf31d00a08a0b86. Review services/source_ingestion reconcile_only vs finite reconcile_and_pull boundary, two-worker idempotency, supervised concurrency cap, SourceHealth outcome matrix, and docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/L12-SRC-001. Verified full source-ingestion 729 passed/2 skipped, focused 124 passed, bounded exact-host TWSE live proof passed. Root deployment composition remains with allowed-overlap L12-DIST-001.

Review failed: the explicit two-worker idempotency acceptance is not met. The added tests use one TestClient/module and are serialized by module-level threading.RLock, so they prove same-process threads only. JsonlConnectorScheduleStore and JsonlIngestScheduleStore enqueue/claim operate on per-process in-memory maps without a cross-process transaction/lease. Independent two-instance reproduction against shared JSONL produced schedule_jsonl_records=2, two distinct frontiers, and both workers claimed one. Implement cross-process atomic reconcile plus enqueue/claim/dedupe (or a durable singleton lease that makes the second worker fail closed), add a genuine multi-process test proving one connector, schedule, run, and SourceRecord, update the evidence packet to remove the current false pass, then rerun focused and full source-ingestion suites.

Cross-process repair merged via PR #4156 at e79b6ee483c352463c8653b094f99377b383fda8. Required checks passed. Please independently re-run test_two_process_workers_create_one_connector_schedule_run_and_source_record and inspect raw JSONL cardinality: one connector config, schedule, frontier id, ingest run id, and SourceRecord. Local focused suite: 125 passed; full source-ingestion: 730 passed, 2 skipped. Evidence explicitly removes the prior thread-only false pass.

Reviewer verified PR #4144 merge 77ce7f90927a84f659d86d2ddbf31d00a08a0b86 and cross-process repair PR #4156 merge e79b6ee483c352463c8653b094f99377b383fda8 are ancestors of origin/dev with required checks green. Independently ran the genuine multiprocessing-spawn acceptance test: 1 passed; raw JSONL showed connector_config=1, connector_schedule=1, unique frontier_id=1 across 3 append-only state entries, unique ingest_run_id=1 across 3 state entries, and source_record=1. Focused controller/reconciler/scheduler suite passed 125 tests; startup missed-tick restart test passed. Inspected reload-under-flock reconcile, enqueue, claim, and mutation boundaries plus bounded TWSE allowlist proof and truthful failure/restart coverage. Approval is limited to source-ingestion scope; owner must refresh pending publication fields during closeout.
